africa-day: (Ekubhiyozeleni uSuku lweAfrika lwama-25, esi Sicelo soQeqesho sePi Pioneers siyaqaliswa)
intro-p1: I-Pi Network yimali yedijithali kunye neprojekthi ye-ecosystem yehlabathi eyenzelwe ukwenza i-cryptocurrency ifikeleleke kwaye ibe luncedo kumntu wonke.
intro-p2: Ngokungafaniyo nezinye ii-cryptocurrencies ezifuna oomatshini bokumba abiza kakhulu, i-Pi Network ivumela abantu abaqhelekileyo ukuba bathathe inxaxheba ngokuthe ngqo kwiifowuni zabo.
intro-list:
• Yakha uqoqosho lwedijithali olubandakanya wonke umntu
  • Xhobisa abantu abaqhelekileyo kwihlabathi liphela
  • Yandisa ukusetyenziswa kokwenyani
  • Xhasa urhwebo lomntu nomntu
ch1-p2: Inyathelo 2: Bhalisa nge-Facebook okanye Ngefowuni → Faka ikhowudi: CHIGALEX1 → Fumana umvuzo we-1 Pi
ch1-p3: Ukugrumba Kwemihla Ngemihla: Buya rhoqo kwiiyure ezingama-24 kwaye ucofe iqhosha lombane ukuze uqhubeke nokugrumba.
ch1-list:
• Yenza isipaji se-Pi ngokukhuselekileyo
  • Gqibezela i-2FA
  • Gqibezela i-KYC
  • Lungiselela ukufuduka kwe-Mainnet
security-msg: ⚠️ Ukhuseleko lwesipaji: Ungaze wabelane ngamagama akho angama-24 e-passphrase! Iqela le-Pi Core SOZE likubuze!
ch2-p1: Isipaji sakho se-Pi yibhanki yakho kwi-Pi Ecosystem. Ibambe iingqekembe zakho ze-Pi ngokukhuselekileyo kwi-blockchain.
ch2-p2: Indlela yokudala: Vula i-Pi Browser → Wallet → Dala i-Wallet → KOPIYA amagama akho angama-24 → Gcina ngaphandle kweintanethi kwiindawo ezi-2 ezikhuselekileyo.
ch2-p3: Ukufumana i-Pi: Yabelana ngedilesi yakho kawonke-wonke (eqala ngo-G...). Ukuthumela i-Pi: Ncamathela idilesi yomamkeli, faka isixa, qinisekisa.
ch2a-p1: Okubonakalayo: Qala ngesixa esincinci sovavanyo (1 Pi). Qinisekisa ukuba oonobumba abane bokuqala nabane bokugqibela bedilesi bayahambelana. Ungaze uncamathele i-passphrase yakho kuyo nayiphi na iwebhusayithi!
ch3-p1: I-Pi Browser ifana ne-Google Play Store ye-Pi. Ii-DApps zizicelo ezisasaziweyo zokusetyenziswa kokwenyani — ukuthenga, imfundo, imidlalo, iinkonzo zonke zisebenzisa i-Pi.
ch4-p1: Fumana amashishini amkela i-Pi kwihlabathi jikelele kwi-mapofpi.com. Bhalisa ishishini lakho kwaye uqale ukwamkela i-Pi ngeempahla neenkonzo.
ch5-p1: Ixabiso LeMvumelwano Yehlabathi (GCV) likhuthaza ukusetyenziswa kokwenyani. 1 Pi = $314,159 GCV. Eli xabiso lakhiwa ngamavulandlela asebenzisa i-Pi kurhwebo lokwenyani.
ch6-p1: Funda incwadi ka-Doris Yin yokudala ukusetyenziswa kunye nokukhula kwe-ecosystem. Phanda, funda, kwaye ufundise abanye — yindlela esixhobisa ngayo iAfrika.
final-msg: I-Afrika inethuba lokuba yenye yezona ndawo zinamandla ekusetyenzisweni okusebenzayo ngaphakathi kwe-Pi Ecosystem. Sikunye Sakha. Sikunye Sifundisa.
